# Tempo

## How the guide defines it

Not addressed in guide.

## How the guide uses it

Two printed categories carry it — plays per game and time of possession — but only on the **offensive** table. The defensive table omits both. The guide also uses tempo in prose as a criticism, as when a contributor worries that Ohio State under coordinator Arthur Smith will play slowly and squander a talent advantage.

## Working definition — TTW DERIVED

How quickly a team runs plays, measured by snaps per game and by how long it holds the ball.

## Why it matters — TTW DERIVED

Tempo inflates or deflates every counting statistic. Two teams with identical efficiency will post very different yardage totals if one runs fifteen more plays a game, which is why per-play rates matter more than totals.

## How bettors use it in this guide

Read off the offensive table as plays per game with a national rank. There is no tempo-based betting system in the guide.
